name: QuestionnaireLinkedRecordSource
title: Questionnaire linked-record source
description: Marks an item whose answer comes from the person's linked record in the host application: it is shown read-only, on the Linked Record tab. Says nothing about where the data comes from (see questionnaire-redcap-source for REDCap). Its value is always true.
